risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified operational, financial, liquidity, and capital expenditure information, including available revolver capacity and insurance proceeds. Risk disclosures identify meaningful exposure to volatile metal prices, regulatory and environmental liabilities, safety incidents, inflation, reserve uncertainty, and financing-market access, but rely partly on standard hedging language and broad forward-looking qualifications. Overall tone is cautiously positive, supported by production and revenue achievements while acknowledging material mining-sector risks.
